hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "$INPUT"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'main_prod|environments/prod|fastlane .*(release|deploy|beta)|xcrun altool|upload.*(appstore|play)'; then echo 'BLOCKED by production red line: production entrypoints, builds, and store uploads are human-only. Releases go through the dev -> qa -> staging -> production promotion chain.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Red line: checking command is not a production build/deploy

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FP" | grep -qiE 'environments/prod/|key\.properties|\.keystore|/\.env|GoogleService-Info|google-services\.json'; then echo 'BLOCKED by production red line: production environment files, signing configs, and Firebase configs are never edited by AI.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Red line: checking edit is not touching prod env or signing files
